title: Endurance Sportswire — 2026 Dragon's Back Race report: 11th edition, Ultra X debut and mandatory route
claims: The 2026 edition drew 210 participants from 20 nations; it was the 11th running and the first under Ultra X ownership.
The event traces its origin to the 1992 inaugural race; the revived modern series has run under Ourea Events before the 2026 change of ownership.
For the 2026 edition the organisers set a single mandatory route for participants, rather than leaving runners to choose their own line between checkpoints.
